newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin workers approve pact.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin workers approve pact.

text.p: The United Auto Workers union said Monday that its members have ratified a new three-year contract with Lockheed Martin.

The agreement, approved by a 76 percent majority, covers a total of about 2,000 members of UAW locals 738 in Baltimore, Maryland; 766 in Denver, Colorado and 788 in Orlando, Florida. The preivous deal expried on November 1, the UAW said.

Key highlights of the new agreement include an up-front, lump-sum payment of up to $2,500 for each worker, representing past cost-of-living adjustments, plus an initial general wage increase of three percent, effective Monday, the union said.
Three percent lump-sum payments were negotiated for each of the second and third years of the agreement, the union said.
